name: 8962-prefillheavy-235ba22bfp8-tp4
model: Qwen/Qwen3-235B-A22B-FP8. NOT SUBSTITUTABLE: the block-quantized FP8 checkpoint (weight_block_size [128, 128]) is part of the setup.
hardware: 4x H100 80GB HBM3, ONE node, no router and no cache tier outside it.
parallelism: TP=4, EP=1 (expert parallelism off), PP=1, DP=1. Forced: TP8 shards moe_intermediate_size 1536 to 192, which is not divisible by the FP8 block width 128, and the server refuses to start; TP2 needs ~111 GiB per card.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=16, warmup the first 20%, bounded at 640 requests with a 1800 s safety cap; ~512 requests measured.
workload: guidellm synthetic_text, SINGLE TURN, no prefix reuse and the engine's prefix cache disabled: 4096 prompt tokens in, 64 output tokens out, both FIXED (no stdev), with ignore_eos true, temperature 0.0 and seed 42.
purpose: A document analysis assistant summarizing long single-turn reports with a large mixture-of-experts model across four GPUs for sixteen concurrent users.
launch:
# sglang server arguments. The interpreter is named by `configs/env.yaml: venv`.
model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-235B-A22B-FP8

# Forced: 1536 / TP must stay divisible by the FP8 block width 128. TP8 gives 192 and the server
# refuses to start; TP2 needs ~111 GiB per card.
tp-size: 4

# Equal to the prompt length, so one prompt is one pass. The stock value here is 8192.
chunked-prefill-size: 4096

# Unset, this commit captures a graph ladder to batch 160: minutes of startup and gigabytes of
# graph buffer for batch sizes a 16-stream closed loop never reaches.
cuda-graph-max-bs: 64
disable-radix-cache: true
